messages.text: how was your morning then
oh it was alright you know walked out through the east fields and a baby cow came right up to me just stood there with me for a bit my little friend
that sounds like a gentle start to the day
yeah it was nice I do that most days walk about five or six miles round the village through the fields
what makes you head out that way so often
well I work from home as a bookkeeper so it's just good to get out you know
and what does being out there do for you
makes me feel calm just being outside
did the little one follow you far
no just a few minutes then it wandered off back to the others
do you have a favourite stretch of the walk
the bit along the old hedge line is probably the best quietest
sounds like a good way to spend the day
yeah it's simple but it works for me
morning, sam. how does the day feel so far?
oh, it's alright, a bit grey out, you know. I'm hoping the rain holds off for a walk later.
a walk sounds nice. any plan for the rest of the day?
um, yeah, I'll probably head over to my mum's house this afternoon.
that's a kind thing to do. what's the weather doing right now?
it's just overcast at the moment, not raining yet, so that's something.
do you have a favourite path for your walk?
there's a lane behind the church, quiet, with a bit of a view over the fields if the clouds lift.
you had a good day today?
yeah it was good, you know, just a normal sort of day.
did you get outside at all?
yeah I got my walk in and down by the beck there was this heron just hovering over the water, made me smile.
oh that sounds lovely, and did you see anyone today?
went to my mum's for a bit, she says her knee's been bad again.
that must have been a nice visit though?
yeah it was alright, just sat and had a cuppa with her.
so all in all a decent sort of day then?
yeah it was a good day, I can't complain.
how's your afternoon going, sam
oh, bit flat really, been stuck at my desk all day with the accounts
that sounds like a heavy slog
yeah, just one of those days where the numbers don't seem to add up
is there anything that's felt a little lighter today
um not really, just been staring at the screen mostly
morning, sam. what's catching your eye today?
oh, there's golden leaves everywhere this morning, you know, all over the path.
that sounds like a nice start to the day
yeah, I'm in a better mood than on Sunday, that's for sure
got anything planned for later?
I'm looking forward to catching up with my friend Morgan this evening
long day?
yeah, bit of a long one, you know, just work stuff mostly.
did anything nice happen at all?
oh, I got out for a bit with Morgan, that was good, we just walked and talked for a while.
how’s Morgan doing these days?
he’s thinking about Scotland maybe next year, nothing settled though, just talking.
that’s a big idea, Scotland.
I could never live in a city again myself, not after living here.
you feel alright about that, being in the village?
I notice I always feel lighter after I’ve been out, I should go out before work really but I never do.
what keeps you from going out in the morning?
just the usual, you know, getting going, it’s easier to put it off.
so you’re glad you went out with Morgan today then.
yeah, it was nice, cleared my head a bit.
morning, sam, how are you feeling today?
not great, to be honest, slept badly last night, bit tired, but I'm still heading out in a bit.
what's the weather like out there?
it's grey, you know, typical october mist, but I don't mind it really.
did anything make you smile this morning?
well, I was thinking, if I won the lottery I'd just buy a wee cottage by the sea, that's the dream.
sounds like a nice thought to hold onto.
yeah, it's a daft joke really, but it keeps me going.
are you walking somewhere or driving?
walking today, just down to the post office and back.
evening time now, how was your day today
oh it was alright, you know, I went for a walk up the hill just before sunset
did something stand out on the walk
well I saw some deer, just a few of them, they were moving about on the hill and it was really quiet, that was probably the best bit of the whole week actually
that sounds like a lovely moment, was it just you and them up there
yeah just me, I stopped for a bit and watched them, they didn't seem to mind me being there
did you stay up there until it got dark
no I came back before it went proper dark, just as the sun was going down behind the hill
and how is the walk back home when it's nearly dark
it's alright, a bit cooler, the fields look different in that half-light you know
do you think you'll go up that way again tomorrow
maybe, if the weather holds, it's nice to just go up there
morning sam, how's your saturday shaping up so far?
oh not much really, just been pottering about the garden, you know how it is
any plans for the rest of the weekend?
well I keep saying I'll go to the coast for a day but I never do, seems a bit silly really
what's the garden like this time of year?
bit damp to be honest, the leaves are all coming down, I'll probably just tidy up a bit later
does the quiet suit you today?
yeah I suppose so, it's peaceful enough
morning, sam. what’s the day looking like for you?
oh, morning. slept well, just desk work today.
that sounds steady. anyone coming round or is it quiet?
no, mum’s staying at my aunt’s this week, so no visits for now.
right, so a bit of peace then. how’s the desk treatin’ you so far?
it’s alright, got a few bits to sort through, nothing major.
nice to have a calm stretch sometimes. any tea in the plans?
yeah, I’ll probably put the kettle on in a bit.
good call. hope the day keeps easy for you.
you went out to the coast today, didn’t you?
yeah I finally went down to saltburn, walked the pier a bit.
did the air feel different out there?
it did, yeah. proper fresh, you know. made me forget about things for a while.
was it a spur-of-the-moment thing?
not really. I was feeling a bit stuck indoors so I just got in the car.
and did it help, heading out like that?
it always does, actually. I don’t know why I don’t remember that more often.
walking on a pier makes you think about the horizon, doesn’t it?
yeah it does. I was thinking, maybe one day I’d like somewhere quieter by the sea.
just thinking, not planning anything?
just thinking. a little cottage somewhere, maybe. nothing serious.
that sounds like a nice thought to carry home with you.
it is. makes the drive back feel a bit lighter.
